title: Hanasato Minori — Each Dream Weaves Another〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm glad I had just practiced that song! My singing and dancing were right on point!)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Great work, everyone!
Here, take a towel.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It really was a wonderful show.
Do you perform there regularly?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. We do a performance every month.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But we never thought we'd have the pleasure of seeing you in our audience, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. I hope Miku and the others will join us next time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, this is the celebrated big draw of MORE MORE PARK!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-MORE MORE PARK?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey now, I get KAITO, but haven't you already danced on that stage countless times?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh... H-Hahaha!
Y-You're totally right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What is all of this about?
I don't know anything about a MORE MORE PARK...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is a SEKAI formed from a fragment of a feeling, so apparently it's a little bit...no, significantly different from reality.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
And I'm sure Airi and the others are residents of this SEKAI.
For one thing, they don't seem to be questioning why I'm not a hologram.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I...see?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is just another SEKAI, so there's no need to think too hard about it. Besides, this one is like a dream you're fated to wake up from before too long.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So while you're here in this dream, it's fine to do as you like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
You said this place is going to disappear before long.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That feels like a waste... It's such an adorable, wonderful place.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In that case, I hope you'll take a good look around this SEKAI and absorb the feeling behind it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're right! I want to learn more about it, and see all the places I can go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's a little early, but should we head to the next spot?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, next spot?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. We still have our autograph session and plenty of other work to do today, so let's head over with the MORE MORE CAR.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ooh! An autograph session sounds fun... Wait, the MORE MORE CAR?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Seriously, what's with you today?
Don't you see it right there?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Th-That car...!
I was wondering about it a bit since it has that clover mark on it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
W-Wow!
So that's our very own car!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Look, is this really your first time hearing this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe, I know how she feels.
After all, I still get so excited every time we ride in it too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's so great that you get to ride around such a beautiful place in such a cute car!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm having fun just thinking about it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's head out once we're all ready!

rows.Speaker: Minori, KAITO, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Everyone, thank you for your cooperation.
Please move ahead in a safe and orderly fashion.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Fan
rows.Line: U-Um... Minori, uhh... Hello!!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She's like how I was the first time I lined up for Haruka's autograph.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hello to you too!
How was it getting here?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Fan
rows.Line: Um, I actually live really close...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I see! That must be nice with the sea so close by.
Can you see it from where you live?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Fan
rows.Line: Y-Yes! I can smell the sea breeze on windy days, and I also hang out with my friends on the beach during summer break!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, getting to hang out on the beach sounds fun!
Actually, I have a big doggie at home named Samo, and...

rows.Speaker: Cameraman
rows.Line: Very nice! Your expressions are quite natural, so it feels as though I'm getting photos of you just as you are.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It's all thanks to your skills.
The shoot has gone smoothly with you behind the camera.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I know. There's still time left, so how about taking some photos under a different scenario?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
This meat is done, everyone.
Keep on taking any that you want.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
The egg soup is ready as well.
Here you are, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, Shizuku!
Ahh, eating barbeque after work is just the best!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
We have the MORE MORE CAR to thank.
I was surprised to find out it's a pretty well-equipped camper.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It looks like we'd be pretty late getting back to MORE MORE PARK, so let's stay the night here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That sounds good.
There's also somebody else who's been working just as tirelessly as we have.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hm?
If you're referring to me, there's no need to worry—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, I insist.
KAITO, please hand me the tongs.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, but some of the meat is still—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's fine, we'll keep an eye on it!
Here, some rice and your chopsticks!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ahhh!
We're back!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That was so fun, it was like we were on tour!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now that's an exaggeration.
No tour wraps up that quickly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, going to a faraway city we wouldn't normally visit, meeting our fans and then sharing a delicious meal sounds pretty close to me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree. Other than that...
If we'd just eaten some delicacies that are popular or unique to the area, I think that would have made it the perfect tour.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That means, if we'd just caught some fish and put them on the barbeque...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What are you talking about?! That might be local, but it doesn't sound popular or unique to me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka, KAITO & Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I had so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One day, I hope we can go on a real...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... Now that I think about it, I used to tell myself that I hoped I could appear on TV someday.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Just a little while ago, I was thinking to myself about how great it would be to become an idol like Haruka, or how I wanted to perform with her someday after I debuted.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But now...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Minori?
What's the matter?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Up till now, we've made so many of our hopes come true, like getting our own original song and outfits or putting on a solo show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was thinking, I really wanna make this one come true too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Of course, we don't want to let it just be a dream.
This will help us give our fans hope for tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, if we're planning to do a show at THE Butokan, we've gotta be able to eat a tour or two for breakfast!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I feel the same. If we all put in the effort, we'll be sure to reach any goal.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want us to have more and more and more hope, and deliver it to people all over!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It appears we're back in the SEKAI we know.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... That SEKAI was so cute, I wish I could've sung there more and done other work there...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ah, wait!
We were there for a full day, right?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Check the time.
I don't think much time has passed since we entered that fragment SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Oh, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: MORE MORE PARK, the MORE MORE CAR... It feels like I just had the most miraculous dream.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But you don't want to let it just be a dream, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna keep doing my best to deliver hope for tomorrow, right beside Haruka and the others!
